calls.statement:
SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, c.start_date, c.end_date, c.holdout_pct, c.mailing_list_size, c.holdout_size,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM campaign_holdout h WHERE h.campaign_id=c.campaign_id) AS rows_h,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM campaign_holdout h WHERE h.campaign_id=c.campaign_id) AS dist_h
FROM dim_campaign c ORDER BY start_date

WITH h AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15),
t AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15),
hm AS (SELECT h.member_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member m WHERE m.member_id=h.member_id) AS nver FROM h)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM h) AS holdout_distinct,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM t) AS targeted_distinct,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h JOIN t USING(member_id)) AS in_both,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM hm WHERE nver=0) AS holdout_not_in_dim_member,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15) AS holdout_rows,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_id=h.member_id AND m.is_current AND NOT m.marketing_consent) AS holdout_current_noconsent,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=15) AS exposure_rows,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM bak_dim_campaign_2025 WHERE campaign_id=15) AS bak

WITH h AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15)
SELECT count(*) AS n,
 sum(CASE WHEN (SELECT min(join_date) FROM dim_member m WHERE m.member_id=h.member_id) > DATE '2025-11-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS joined_after,
 sum(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_member m WHERE m.member_id=h.member_id AND m.valid_from<=DATE '2025-11-24' AND m.valid_to>=DATE '2025-11-24' AND m.marketing_consent) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_consent_at_start,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15 GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_ids
FROM h
